about_the_game:
In Rotor Horizon, you take control of a combat helicopter in a post-apocalyptic world dominated by AI. Fly freely across vast open-world environments, strike enemy bases, gather resources, and craft more powerful machines to push deeper into hostile territory.

Key Features

  • Helicopter Control & Exploration
    Experience realistic flight controls as you pilot a combat helicopter and freely explore a devastated world filled with ruins, deserts, and enemy fortresses.

  • Game Modes
    Features single-player survival gameplay. Engage in battles against AI forces, evade patrols, and manage resources to stay alive.

  • Weapons & Aircraft Customization
    Choose from 10 unique helicopters. Equip three weapon types — machine guns, rockets, and missiles — and evolve your aircraft through crafting and upgrades.

  • Enemies & Combat
    Encounter diverse enemies including AI-controlled bases, patrolling helicopters, and heavily armored tank divisions. Combat demands strategy: stealth infiltration, aerial ambush, or direct assault — the choice is yours.

  • Survival & Progression
    Gather materials from missions, wreckage, and hidden caches. Use them to upgrade your aircraft or craft new ones, unlocking deeper challenges.

  • Sound & Graphics
    Realistic visuals and immersive sound design emphasize roaring engines and explosive battles, capturing the intensity of aerial combat.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features combat involving military helicopters against enemy bases and weapons. It includes depictions of gunfire and explosions, but does not contain gore, blood, or human corpses. There are also no depictions of sexual content or drug use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Single-player only.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12 compatible sound card
  • VR Support: VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Single-player only.

short_description: In a world devastated and ruled by AI, pilot a combat helicopter to engage in aerial exploration and battles. Raid enemy bases, gather resources to upgrade your aircraft, and develop new machines as you venture deeper into the open-world survival experience.
